course.name: Bulls on Wall Street
course.tagline: A day and swing trading education platform founded by Kunal Desai in 2008, with a free intro course and a 60-day live bootcamp.
course.about: Bulls on Wall Street is a trading education company founded by Kunal Desai in 2008, who has traded full-time since 2007. It offers a free 25-hour introductory course, a day/swing/options platform called BullsVision, and a 60-day live trading bootcamp combining structured classes, simulator trading, and daily screen-share sessions with Kunal during market hours.

curriculum.title: 60-Day Live Trading Bootcamp
topics: Bone Zone strategy (9 EMA/20 EMA pullbacks)
Day trading, swing trading, options and futures

formats.label: Free intro course
formats.description: A free 25-hour introductory course plus community access.

formats.label: 60-Day Live Bootcamp
formats.description: Live classes 4 nights/week for weeks 1-5 (no live trading allowed yet), then graded simulator trading for weeks 6-9, plus 1 year of chatroom access and lifetime access to recordings.

formats.label: Daily live screen-share
formats.description: Daily screen-share with Kunal during market hours.

formats.label: BullsVision
formats.description: A unified day trading, swing trading and options platform.

pricing.name: BullsVision
pricing.billing_note: Ongoing subscription after the first week.

pricing.name: 60-Day Live Bootcamp
pricing.billing_note: Or 3 payments of $1,200. Price and promotions change often.

_notes.source: One of the most established day trading education brands (founded 2008, 7,000+ traders trained, 80+ bootcamp cohorts per the provider), added for directory credibility rather than affiliate revenue — no affiliate relationship exists. Founder, format and curriculum came directly from bullsonwallstreet.com; the Trustpilot figure (4.7/5, 447 reviews, Excellent) was independently confirmed directly on Trustpilot, not just taken from the provider's own self-reported number. Bootcamp price cross-checked via WebSearch, which shows it has varied over time ($2,850-$3,499 across different snapshots) — noted as subject to change in our own billing_note rather than presenting a single figure as fixed. Logo is the provider's own favicon.
